source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** counts only when this attack targets a unit with neither **MONSTER** nor **VEHICLE**. If even one model in the target unit has either keyword, the whole unit [counts as having it](vsdata:core-rule/keywords), so the ability does nothing. Otherwise, on a critical hit you may declare that the attack wounds without a wound roll. Skipping that roll means the attack can never become a critical wound, so it cannot set off effects like **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)**; you are free to roll normally instead.
